part: MCP6002 dual 1 MHz rail-to-rail op-amp, SOIC-8: the backlight current sinks' error amplifiers
notes: Replaced the AP3156 charge pump (C443652, out of stock at JLC and LCSC, 2026-10-07). The loop (U6 half, Q5/Q6, RG 330, RF 10k, CF 1n) was simulated with Microchip's macromodel before layout: sim/backlight.py, results in sim/backlight_results.txt (phase margin >= 72.5 deg at all 720 corners).
Offset is the accuracy limit at low brightness: +-4.5 mV max against 124 mV at full current (+-3.6%), 22 mV at 18% duty (+-20% worst case per channel).

ratings.cite: p3 Absolute Maximum Ratings; p3 DC specs Supply Voltage

ratings.limit: VSS - 1.0 V to VDD + 1.0 V, +-2 mA; common-mode range VSS - 0.3 V to VDD + 0.3 V
ratings.design: +IN = BL_REF 0-0.13 V (from the 3V3 GPIO through 100k); -IN = sense voltage 0-0.13 V through 10k. With 3V3 off both are 0 V (GPIO off, LEDs off)
124 mV full scale on 2.2 ohm: +-3.6% at full, +-20% at 18% duty (simulated)

ratings.limit: rail-to-rail, VSS + 25 mV / VDD - 25 mV; short-circuit +-6 mA (1.8 V) / +-23 mA (5.5 V); +-30 mA abs max
ratings.design: drives a FET gate (about 1.3-1.5 V) through 330 ohm: mA only while slewing

ratings.limit: datasheet recommends an isolation resistor (RISO) for large capacitive loads
ratings.design: R54/R55 330 ohm to the AO3400A gate (Ciss 630 pF at 15 V, more at low Vds), plus CF 1 nF local feedback; simulated phase margin >= 72.5 deg
